# Fallout Season 2 starts in December 2025

![Fallout Season 2 starts in December 2025](/uploads/510_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Just a few days ago @FalloutonPrime on X announced that filming of the second season of the Fallout series has been completed. Now there is already the next news.

In the current Amazon Upfront Show it was announced that the **2. Season of the Fallout series will be released on Amazon Prime * in December 2025**.

![Fallout 2nd Season Release Date](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fallout-season2-release.jpg) 

The first season of the series was already a complete success and not only convinced die-hard Fallout fans with its fantastic implementation, but also won numerous new Fallout fans. With more than **100 million viewers**, season 1 is already one of the most popular Prime series. Even the Fallout games reached new record popularity and player numbers through the first season of the series.

## Information and cast of the 2nd season

Further information and the cast of the second season can be found in Friday's article. There are also some pictures from the set including Dinky the T-Rex, NCR soldiers and Cesar's Legion in New Vegas.

Fallout on Prime: Filming for the second season of the series has been completed
